candidate.src_content_hash_rule: sha256 over the byte string 'openssl-rs/src-rs/v1\0' followed, for each src/**/*.rs in sorted relative-path order, by relpath\0filebytes\0

closure.source: union of atlas_refresh.MECHANISM_PATHS (the nine Safe-33 mechanism path sets)

method.enclosing_function: atlas_refresh._enclosing_fn: nearest preceding fn at lower indentation (best effort)
method.extern_c_fn_definition_accounting: an `unsafe extern "C" fn` is counted once under UNSAFE_FN_DEF; EXTERN_C_FN_DEF is the disjoint safe-ABI remainder. totals.extern_c_fn_definitions_total records the full number of named per-item `extern "C" fn` definitions. Function-pointer types such as `extern "C" fn(...)` are not definitions and are not counted.
method.source_partition: production = not in a #[cfg(test)] module/item and not an allocator-seam file; test_only = in a #[cfg(test)] inline module/item or a file pulled in by #[cfg(test)] mod name; allocator_seam = src/runtime/mem.rs or src/runtime/secure.rs. The partition order is seam, then test, then production.
method.stripping: atlas_refresh.strip_comments_and_literals; offsets and 1-based line numbers are preserved. The ABI string literal immediately after `extern` is restored so `extern "C"` remains visible; comments and every other literal stay stripped.

prior_census.reason: schema and count categories consulted; not reused because the artifact is bound to a different source candidate and does not provide this production/test/seam lexical partition
